title: Max 40 hours a week
ownerWords: Forty is the most, full stop. Anything over forty is a no, and breaks count in the hours. Even if someone's out sick, I'd rather be short than have someone burnt out.
precise: For each person, the total rostered hours in a week (Monday to Sunday) must not exceed 40. Breaks count as rostered hours. Exactly 40 is allowed; 41 or more is not. This applies to all staff, including those on smaller contracts who pick up extra shifts, and applies even when cover is needed for sickness.
whyKind: Total rostered hours per person per week, including breaks, can be added up directly from the rota, so code can decide it from the facts alone.
howItWorks: The check adds up every shift each person is rostered for across the week, breaks included. Anyone whose total goes above 40 hours gets a message, while exactly 40 hours is allowed.
